## Biography

Amelia is an undergraduate student at the University of Central Florida pursuing studies in GIS and Sustainability. She has experience in geospatial analysis, environmental research, and sustainability-focused projects, with interests in applying GIS to environmental and geographic challenges. After graduation, Amelia plans to attend the School of Forest, Fisheries, and Geomatics Sciences at the University of Florida to further develop her skills in geospatial technologies and their applications. Her interests include GIS, environmental sustainability, and using geospatial analysis to better understand and address real-world environmental challenges.
